THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
NIGHT & LIFESTYLE
152
STUDY 053
Striped Tank & Denim Lounge
Rights check
Source: 24390.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with wavy, sun-kissed blonde
hair sits on a white couch with her knees drawn up. She
wears a red-and-white striped tank top with a small bow
detail and light wash straight-leg denim jeans. Red
chunky platform sandals complete the look. Her
expression is calm, looking straight at the camera.
Warm, golden indoor light and a plain beige wall behind
her. Palette of cream, denim blue, and cherry red.
Relaxed and nostalgic, in the style of a 2000s lifestyle
photo.
Relaxed, nostalgic, candid
WORKING NOTES
- The red sandals and striped tank create the color
accents.
- Keep the warm light for a sunny, relaxed feel.
